effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] If it's your turn, you may play 1 level 3 or lower Digimon card with [Chessmon] in its name from your hand without paying its cost. If you have 8 or more Digimon cards with [Chessmon] in its name in their names in your trash, add 2 to the maximum level of the card you can play by this effect.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
